data.description: The creature retains any subtype except for alignment subtypes (such as evil) and subtypes that indicate kind (such as giant). It does not gain the augmented subtype. An ectoplasmic creature loses the base creature's defensive abilities. An ectoplasmic creature loses most special qualities of the base creature. It retains any extraordinary special qualities that improve its melee or ranged attacks.
data.name: Ectoplasmic Creature Alterations
